name: list-templates
description: List all email templates from Resend. Returns template names, statuses, and aliases. Don't bother telling the user the IDs unless they ask for them.

limit.description: Number of templates to retrieve. Default: 20, Max: 100, Min: 1

after.description: Template ID after which to retrieve more (for forward pagination). Cannot be used with "before".

before.description: Template ID before which to retrieve more (for backward pagination). Cannot be used with "after".
